sources.title: महानारायणोपनिषत्
sources.licence: CC BY-SA 4.0 (transcription); work itself public domain
sources.note: Taittiriya Aranyaka 10 (Mahanarayana Upanishad). Anuvaka 35.2 gives the pranayama unit (seven vyahritis + Gayatri + शिरस् आपो ज्योती रसोऽमृतं) in the Taittiriya reading सुवः/सुवरोम्; 15.2, 37.1, 68.2 repeat the shiras. Used to verify the Garuda-Purana reading of the vyahritis and the shiras; the Taittiriya reading is recorded as a variant.

sources.title: वाचस्पत्यम्/आघार
sources.licence: CC BY-SA 4.0 (transcription); work itself public domain (Taranatha Tarkavachaspati, 1873–1884)
sources.note: Sanskrit lexicon; the entry आचमन quotes the smriti rule of the Vaishnava achamana — three sips with the names beginning केशव (ॐ केशवाय नमः इत्यादि नामभिः आचमनम्), the next names for washing the hands — and lists the twenty-four names in order (केशव, नारायण, माधव, गोविन्द, विष्णु …). Copy source for the achamana name-formula; order and recited form checked against sd-syv-sandhya.

sources.title: लौगाक्षि गृह्य सूत्राणि/कण्डिका ०१-१०
sources.licence: CC BY-SA 4.0 (transcription); work itself public domain

sources.title: शान्तिपाठः (शान्तयः सस्वराः निस्श्वराः च)
sources.licence: sanskritdocuments.org terms: personal study; not to be copied without permission (brief §14 applies)
sources.note: Collection of the Upanishadic shanti mantras of all four Vedas with svara (सह नाववतु, शं नो मित्रः, भद्रं कर्णेभिः, पूर्णमदः, the Taittiriya ghosha-shanti …). Second source: GRETIL sa_garuDapurANa.txt (garp_2,5.x numbering agrees).

Used to verify the gotra fallback quoted in part 1.

sources.title: Drik Panchang — सङ्कल्प मन्त्र utility (sankalpa.html, Hindi)
sources.licence: © drikpanchang.com (all images and data); used for verification only, nothing copied
sources.note: Fills the full Hindi-belt sankalpa frame with live panchang values for a chosen city. Used to verify the frame wording of the Dwivedi paddhati (it reads अद्यैतस्य ब्रह्मणोऽह्नि द्वितीये परार्धे … भूर्लोके भारतवर्षे जम्बूद्वीपे भरतखण्डे आर्यावर्तान्तर्गतब्रह्मावर्तस्य …, inserts the Vikram year as श्रीमन्नृपतिवीरविक्रमादित्यसमयतः … संख्यापरिमिते प्रवर्तमानसंवत्सरे, and ends with a generic purpose clause) and to confirm the samvatsara name सिद्धार्थी for Vikram 2083 (Kartik 2026, New Delhi). Its own note: samvatsara, lunar month, ayana and ritu are those current at sunrise; the other elements are computed for the moment of the sankalpa.

sources.licence: CC BY-SA 4.0 (transcription); work itself public domain
sources.note: Vasishtha's three-verse Vastoshpati hymn (RV 7.54) with Sayana's commentary; the svara text of each rk is printed inside the commentary block. Source of rv-7-54-1 (the Vastoshpati avahana of the dikpala/vastu worship — the verse is not in the Vajasaneyi Samhita). Second source: the Gita Press Nitya Karma Puja Prakash scan (ia-nkpp-scan), which prints the verse in the vastoshpati-pujana.

sources.title: भविष्यपुराणम् /पर्व ४ (उत्तरपर्व)/अध्यायः १३७
sources.licence: CC BY-SA 4.0 (transcription); work itself public domain
sources.note: Uttara-parva chapter 137 (Krishna–Yudhishthira dialogue on the Shravani-purnima raksha-bandhana): verses 19–20 give the raksha-bandhana mantra येन बद्धो बली राजा … तेन त्वामभिबध्नामि रक्षे मा चल मा चल — the Puranic source of the raksha-sutra verse that every Hindi-belt paddhati recites. Second source: NKPP रक्षा-विधान (reading अनुबध्नामि) and the Dwivedi paddhati (reading प्रतिबध्नामि).

sources.title: विष्णुपुराणम्/प्रथमांशः/अध्यायः १९
sources.licence: CC BY-SA 4.0 (transcription); work itself public domain
sources.note: Vishnu Purana 1.19 (Prahlada's hymn to Vishnu): verse 65 is नमो ब्रह्मण्यदेवाय गोब्राह्मणहिताय च — the tilak verse of the raksha-vidhana (pur-vishnupurana-1-19-65). The same verse occurs in the Narada, Padma and Skanda Puranas and in the Vishnu Sahasranama preamble. Second source: NKPP रक्षा-विधान.

sources.title: याज्ञवल्क्यस्मृतिः/आचाराध्यायः/श्राद्धप्रकरणम्
sources.licence: CC BY-SA 4.0 (transcription); work itself public domain
sources.note: Acharadhyaya 1.217–270 (shraddha-prakarana): 1.247 names वाजे वाजे (VS 9.18) as the mantra for sending off the Brahmins in a shraddha; 1.250 is the smriti rule of the वृद्धि (nandi / abhyudayika) shraddha — the nandimukha ancestors, pradakshina order, curd and jujube in the pindas, barley in place of sesame. Source of pur-yajnavalkya-1-250.

sources.title: शुक्लयजुर्वेदः/अध्यायः ०६
sources.licence: CC BY-SA 4.0 (transcription); work itself public domain
sources.note: Madhyandina Vajasaneyi Samhita adhyaya 6; pada text labelled NN.M with the svara text below it (Uvata and Mahidhara commentary interleaved). Registered by C1A-07 for 6.22 (सुमित्रिया न आप — the marjana / pranita-vimoka of the havan); the ०६ title redirects to अध्यायः ६. Second source: TITUS.

sources.title: शुक्लयजुर्वेदः/अध्यायः २२
sources.licence: CC BY-SA 4.0 (transcription); work itself public domain
sources.note: Madhyandina Vajasaneyi Samhita adhyaya 22; pada text labelled NN.M with the svara text below it (Uvata and Mahidhara commentary interleaved). Registered by C1A-07 for 22.17 (अग्निं दूतं पुरो दधे — agni-sthapana). Second source: TITUS.

sources.title: शुक्लयजुर्वेदः/अध्यायः २४
sources.licence: CC BY-SA 4.0 (transcription); work itself public domain
sources.note: Madhyandina Vajasaneyi Samhita adhyaya 24; pada text labelled NN.M with the svara text below it (Uvata and Mahidhara commentary interleaved). Registered by C1A-06 for 24.3 (शुद्धवालः सर्वशुद्धवालो — the shuddhodaka-snana mantra of the shodashopachara; the Gita Press handbook labels it 24.2). Second source: TITUS.

sources.title: नारदपुराणम्- पूर्वार्धः/अध्यायः ६७
sources.licence: CC BY-SA 4.0 (transcription); work itself public domain
sources.note: Narada Purana purvardha chapter 67 (the general puja-paddhati of the Purana): verses 114–117 carry the three kshama-prarthana verses recited at the end of every puja (अन्यथा शरणं नास्ति …, अपराधसहस्राणि …, आवाहनं न जानामि …) with the readings क्षमस्व परमेश्वर / क्षमस्व जगतां पते / त्वं गतिः परमेश्वर; 111 has the द्रव्यहीनं क्रियाहीनं मंत्रहीनं form. Check source for pad-avahanam-na-janami, pad-anyatha-sharanam-nasti, pad-aparadha-sahasrani (the handbook readings stand in devanagari).

sources.title: बृहत्संहिता/अध्यायः ४७
sources.licence: CC BY-SA 4.0 (transcription); work itself public domain
sources.note: Varahamihira's Brihat Samhita chapter 47 (pushya-snana): verse 78 is the classical visarjana verse यान्तु देवगणाः सर्वे पूजामादाय पार्थिवात् । सिद्धिं दत्त्वा तु विपुलां पुनरागमनाय च — the oldest dated form of the paddhati visarjana (6th century). Check source for pad-yantu-devaganah-sarve.

sources.title: स्कन्दपुराणम्/खण्डः २ (वैष्णवखण्डः)/कार्तिकमासमाहात्म्यम्/अध्यायः ३१
sources.licence: CC BY-SA 4.0 (transcription); work itself public domain
sources.note: Skanda Purana, Vaishnava-khanda, Kartika-masa-mahatmya chapter 31 (Tulsi-vivaha vidhi): verse 38 is the visarjana verse गच्छ गच्छ सुरश्रेष्ठ स्वस्थाने परमेश्वर । यत्र ब्रह्मादयो देवास्तत्र गच्छ जनार्दन — copy source of pad-gachchha-gachchha-surashreshtha. Second source: the Gita Press handbook (हुताशन at the agni-visarjana; मम पूजां गृहीत्वेमां in the parthiva-pujana).

sources.title: पाण्डवगीता
sources.licence: CC BY-SA 4.0 (transcription); work itself public domain
sources.note: The Pandava Gita (Prapanna Gita), an anthology of verses of surrender spoken by the Pandavas and others: verse 12, Gandhari's त्वमेव माता च पिता त्वमेव …, is the prayer verse recited after the aarti in the Hindi-belt handbooks. Copy source of pad-tvameva-mata-cha-pita. Second source: the Gita Press handbook (parthiva-pujana, Lakshmi-pujana).

sources.title: अग्निपुराणम्/अध्यायः १६७
sources.licence: CC BY-SA 4.0 (transcription); work itself public domain
sources.note: Agni Purana chapter 167 (dana-vidhi): verse 22 is the dakshina verse हिरण्यगर्भगर्भस्थं हेमबीजं विभावसोः । अनन्तपुण्यफलदमतः शान्तिं प्रयच्छ मे recited at the dakshina of every shodashopachara — copy source of pad-hiranyagarbha-garbhastham. Second source: the Gita Press handbook and the Dwivedi paddhati.

sources.title: बौधायनगृह्यसूत्रम्/प्रश्नः २
sources.licence: CC BY-SA 4.0 (transcription); work itself public domain
sources.note: Baudhayana Grihya Sutra prashna 2 (upanayana): 2.5.7 prescribes the yajnopavita with the mantra यज्ञोपवीतं परमं पवित्रं प्रजापतेर्यत्सहजं पुरस्तात् । आयुष्यमग्रियं प्रतिमुञ्च शुभ्रं यज्ञोपवीतं बलमस्तु तेजः — copy source of pad-yajnopavitam-paramam-pavitram (the paddhatis read अग्र्यं). Second source: the Gita Press handbook.

sources.title: दीक्षाप्रकाशः
sources.licence: CC BY-SA 4.0 (transcription); work itself public domain
sources.note: Dikshaprakasha, a Shaiva ritual digest: in its Shiva-dhyana it prints कर्पूरगौरं करुणावतारं … with the reading सदा रमन्तं हृदयारविन्दे (the handbooks read वसन्तं). The only Sanskrit Wikisource page carrying the verse; used as the check source of pad-karpura-gauram-karunavataram.

sources.title: स्कन्दपुराणम्/खण्डः १ (माहेश्वरखण्डः)/अरुणाचलमाहात्म्यम् १/अध्यायः ०९
sources.licence: CC BY-SA 4.0 (transcription); work itself public domain
sources.note: Skanda Purana, Maheshvara-khanda, Arunachala-mahatmya 1 chapter 9: verse 23 reads यानि कानि च पापानि जन्मांतरकृतानि च । तानि तानि विनश्यंति प्रदक्षिणपदे पदे — the Puranic parallel of the pradakshina verse of the handbooks (तानि सर्वाणि नश्यन्तु). Check source of pad-yani-kani-cha-papani.

sources.title: स्कन्दपुराणम्/खण्डः २ (वैष्णवखण्डः)/मार्गशीर्षमासमाहात्म्यम्/अध्यायः ०८
sources.licence: CC BY-SA 4.0 (transcription); work itself public domain
sources.note: Skanda Purana, Vaishnava-khanda, Margashirsha-masa-mahatmya chapter 8 (dhupa, dipa and nirajana mahatmya): verse 37, मन्त्रहीनं क्रियाहीनं यत्कृतं पूजनं मम । सर्वं संपूर्णतामेति कृते नीराजने, is the Purana's own statement on the aarti — copy source of pur-skanda-margashirsha-8-37 (phalashruti).

sources.title: मत्स्यपुराणम्/अध्यायः २६७
sources.licence: CC BY-SA 4.0 (transcription); work itself public domain
sources.note: Matsya Purana chapter 267 (pratishtha: snana and nirajana): 267.17–18 prescribe the nirajana and the achamana with मन्दाकिन्यास्तु यद्वारि सर्वपापापहं शुभम् — the Puranic first half of the shuddhodaka-snana verse of the handbooks. Check source of pad-mandakinyas-tu-yad-vari.

sources.title: शुक्लयजुर्वेदः/अध्यायः २१
sources.licence: CC BY-SA 4.0 (transcription); work itself public domain
sources.note: Madhyandina Vajasaneyi Samhita adhyaya 21; pada text labelled NN.M with the svara text below it (Uvata and Mahidhara commentary interleaved). Registered by C1A-07 for 21.3–4 (त्वं नो अग्ने, स त्वं नो अग्ने — the first two prayashchitta oblations). Second source: TITUS.

sources.title: बृहदारण्यक उपनिषद् 5p
sources.licence: CC BY-SA 4.0 (transcription); work itself public domain
sources.note: Plain (unaccented) Kanva text of adhyaya 5; 5.1.1 is the शान्तिब्राह्मण opening ॐ पूर्णमदः पूर्णमिदम्. The accented pages (बृहदारण्यक उपनिषद् 1–5) carry the Madhyandina recension in a critical notation and do not contain this verse. Second source: Shatapatha 14.8.1 (ws-shatapatha-14-8-1).

sources.title: शतपथब्राह्मणम्/काण्डम् १४/अध्यायः ८/ब्राह्मणम् ०१
sources.licence: CC BY-SA 4.0 (transcription); work itself public domain
sources.note: Madhyandina Shatapatha 14.8.1 (= Brihadaranyaka Madhyandina), the शांतिब्राह्मण: ॐ पूर्णमदः … (the page omits the visarga of अवशिष्यते). Verification of the purnamadah verse within the Shukla Yajurveda tradition.

sources.title: Agnihotra Havan Vidhi (Arya Pratinidhi Sabha, Jammu & Kashmir) — archive.org scan with OCR
sources.licence: archive.org CC0 marking; Arya Samaj booklet — sequence facts only
sources.note: Arya Samaj havan: samidha mantra ओम् अयं त इध्म आत्मा जातवेदः, जल प्रसेचन ओम् अदिते अनुमन्यस्व, ओम् भूर्-अग्नये प्राणाय स्वाहा, eight अष्टाज्याहुति beginning त्वं नो अग्ने, Gayatri ahutis. Used only for the Arya Samaj variant note on the havan page (decisions.md §1.6 labels the tradition separately).
